notes.title: Update Notice | Rearview Mirror Added to the Little Plane
notes.notes:
Dear Pilots,

To help you stay more in control while soaring through the skies, we’ve added a rearview mirror to the little plane! Now, you can clearly see the tornado chasing you from behind and react in time to dodge or adjust your strategy.

Come and try out this new feature to make your flights even more thrilling and safe!

notes.title: ✈ Update Notice | Green Wings Upgrade ✈
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]
Dear Pilots,

In this update, we’ve made a special upgrade to the Green Wings aircraft!
It now offers a completely new flying experience:

✨ Greatly improved maneuverability — much more agile and precise than the starter model
⚡ Faster fuel recovery — get back into the skies quicker
🛡 Reduced armor — a trade-off made for extreme performance

This upgraded Green Wings may feel a bit “fragile” for beginners,
but in the hands of skilled players, it will surely become a true blade of the skies.

Give it a try!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777488/fd8ac7318ddf46bb4c67894700eaecae1bc0fdbd.gif"]

notes.title: 🌪 Update Announcement | The Endless Chaser Arrives! 🌪
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update, we’re introducing a brand-new character to the game — “The Endless Chaser: a cute little tornado”.
After you’ve been flying for a while, it will appear behind you and stick close, bringing new tension and excitement to your journey.
Tornado Features
Normal Chase: Follows steadily at a base speed, which slowly increases over time.

Angry State: If you’ve been flying too long without taking damage, or if you pull too far ahead, it becomes furious and speeds up!

Tired State: When it catches up to you, or when you collide with something, it will get exhausted and slow down temporarily.

The tornado never gives up — it will always linger behind you, making every flight more thrilling and challenging.
Now, it’s not just about flying far, but also flying smart!

Take on the all-new endless chase today!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777488/99733ed4f7506e185c257c84b1a8c4ec0a3f875c.png"]

notes.title: Update Announcement | Major Visual Upgrade
notes.notes:
Dear players,

In this update, we’ve made a major upgrade to the game’s visuals. After a period of optimization and adjustments, the overall visual style has now been switched to a cartoon style.

In the new visuals:

Environments are brighter and more cheerful in tone

Aircraft and objects have greater clarity and charm

Enhanced depth and layering provide a clearer visual experience

We hope this new style brings you a more comfortable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update Announcement | “The Endless Chaser” is Coming!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We’ve received some feedback from you:
“The gameplay feels too easy, I almost fell asleep while playing…”

Although this is a bit different from our original design philosophy, we’ve taken it seriously and decided to bring you a little “surprise”—

✨ New Challenge: The Endless Chaser ✨

In an upcoming update, a mysterious presence will join the game.
Its form is unknown, but its pursuit never stops.
No matter how fast or far you fly, it will quietly draw closer from the shadows.

This means:

You must stay alert at all times.

Every flight will become more tense and thrilling.

Sleepiness? Sorry, it won’t give you that chance anymore!

Thank you for all your feedback and support. We hope this new feature will bring you an experience like never before.
Are you ready? The true endless challenge is about to begin!

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update, we’ve given the UI a little makeover to make it look cuter and more delightful.
The overall style is now lighter and friendlier, so hopefully it brings you a more relaxed and cheerful vibe while playing.

It’s just a small detail tweak, but we believe it makes the whole experience feel nicer.
Come and check out the refreshed interface!

notes.title: 🎮 Hotfix Notice 🎮
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just released a small hotfix to address the following issue:

Fixed a bug where some controller inputs were not responding correctly.

If you’ve encountered this problem before, it should now be resolved.
Thank you so much for your quick feedback!

Enjoy the game 🎮✨

notes.title: ✈ Game Update Announcement ✈
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update, we’ve mainly fixed the following issues:

Fixed a bug where too much health could be lost at once

Fixed an issue where players couldn’t interact with rewards after losing health

Fixed a problem where sound effects didn’t play correctly after losing health

And here’s some great news:
Tomorrow we’ll be adding a brand-new little plane as a free update in the DLC—stay tuned!

Thank you all for your support and feedback. Have fun playing!

notes.title: 【Minor Update Notice】
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we’ve released a minor update for ✈Velocity Wings✈:

Optimized the in-game score display: now only the overall score is shown on the main menu (since showing it during gameplay felt a bit cluttered)

Adjusted the collision sizes of some obstacles

Improved the pacing of dynamic difficulty to make the overall experience tighter

If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please let us know. Your feedback is very important for improvements. 



——Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 🎉【Official Release Announcement】🎉
notes.notes:
Dear flight enthusiasts,

After a period of careful polishing, our endless flight mini-game \[Velocity Wings] is officially live! ✈️💨
Here, you can experience the freedom and challenge of flying, collect stars, and push your own limits!

We’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions—every comment is our motivation 💌
Whether it’s about gameplay, controls, or your creative ideas, feel free to share!

At the same time, we’re planning a free DLC, hoping to bring even more surprises and fun✨
Details will be announced soon, so stay tuned!

Thank you all for your support, and let’s soar higher together in the skies!

— \[Velocity Wings] Development Team
